pop.description: Polished, radio-friendly music engineered for wide appeal. Catchy hooks, produced vocals, and a blend of synthesiser and live instrumentation. The genre prioritises accessibility over complexity.
pop.avoid_if: listener wants acoustic warmth, jazz complexity, or lo-fi texture

lofi.description: Low-fidelity hip-hop and chill beats defined by mellow rhythms, vinyl crackle, and warm lo-fi textures. Intentionally imperfect production creates a relaxed, nostalgic feel perfect for sustained focus.
lofi.avoid_if: listener needs high energy, fast tempo, or a distinct vocal performance

rock.description: Guitar-driven music emphasising raw power, dynamic contrasts, and live performance energy. Ranges from melodic alternative rock to hard rock. Generally the highest energy genre in the catalog.
rock.avoid_if: listener needs calm, focused, or acoustic music

jazz.description: Harmonically rich, improvisational music rooted in swing and bebop traditions. Complex chord progressions, expressive soloists, and sophisticated rhythm. Typically relaxed to moderate energy with warm acoustics.
jazz.avoid_if: listener wants driving beats, high energy, or modern electronic production

ambient.description: Atmospheric, texture-driven music that creates immersive sonic environments with minimal rhythmic structure. Long sustaining sounds and slow movement designed for passive listening or meditative focus.
ambient.avoid_if: listener needs tempo, energy, or a memorable melody to stay engaged

synthwave.description: Retro-futuristic electronic music inspired by 1980s film scores. Analog synthesisers, driving bass lines, and cinematic atmosphere. Bridges electronic intensity with emotional depth.
synthwave.avoid_if: listener wants acoustic warmth, live instruments, or upbeat positivity

indie pop.description: Melodic, hook-driven music that combines the DIY aesthetic of indie rock with the accessibility of mainstream pop. Warmer, more organic production. Wide emotional range from bittersweet to jubilant.
indie pop.avoid_if: listener wants aggressive energy, pure electronic production, or minimal acoustics
